data.body:
Closing as OBSOLETE. This ticket tracked "Design A" (make the reconciler differ canonicalize
description via the codec's decode_inbound) as the fix for jira-reb-3526's theorized description
churn. An operator-directed verification (24h of live GitHub Actions "Reconcile Bridge" logs + an
empirical codec round-trip) established that the write path ALREADY canonicalizes both sides via the
codec (the pinned codec law `normalize_outbound == decode_inbound(to_wire)`), blank lines survive
the round trip, and no churn occurs (0-6 converging description updates per pass, never 2603).
Design A is therefore a no-op. See the full finding on jira-reb-3526. The only residual is the known
read-only reconcile-check diagnostic over-report, tracked separately if the operator wants it.
